If an item lacks a content element (nil.scrub raises NoMethodError), the whole hourly poll aborts and never retries, permanently blocking items below the failing one. The mechanism is verifiable from the diff: no rescue, no retry, newest-first feeds make the failure repeat at the same position. judged_text: poll_feed iterates rss.items with no per-item error isolation while `sidekiq_options retry: false` disables redelivery: an item lacking a content element (plain RSS 2.0 feeds use <description>, not <content:encoded>, leaving i.content nil so `nil.scrub` raises NoMethodError), an item with a nil title (PostCreator inserts NULL against topics.title NOT NULL), or a previously-imported item whose post was deleted (PostRevisor.new(nil)) all raise inside the loop and abort the entire run. The first failing feed item kills every hourly poll at the same position each run (feeds are newest-first), so all articles below it are never imported — feed ingestion silently halts site-wide until the offending item rotates out of the feed, and with retry: false nothing ever reports or retries the loss.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If a feed item lacks `content` (common for RSS 2.0 which uses `description`), `i.content` can be `nil` and `nil.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the entire poll run. There is no per-item rescue/isolation, and the job explicitly sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so a single bad item can repeatedly kill hourly polling with no retry. Additionally, `TopicEmbed.import`'s update path does `post = embed.post` and then `PostRevisor.new(post)` if content changed; if the associated post was deleted (possible since `post_id` is stored), `post` will be nil and can also raise during the loop, similarly aborting the run.
